name: seat-router
description: Routes marked Agent calls through durable external seats

heavySeats.title: Heavy seats
heavySeats.description: The candidates a heavy seat runs on, in the order tried: comma-separated `<codex|agy|claude> <model> [effort]` entries.
heavySeats.default: codex gpt-5.6-terra xhigh, agy claude-opus-5-5 high, agy gemini-4-argon high, claude opus xhigh

standardSeats.title: Standard seats
standardSeats.description: The candidates a standard seat runs on, in the order tried.
standardSeats.default: codex gpt-5.6-terra high, agy claude-sonnet-5-5 high, agy gemini-3.8-flash high, claude sonnet high

lightSeats.title: Light seats
lightSeats.description: The candidates a light seat runs on, in the order tried.
lightSeats.default: codex gpt-6-luna medium, agy gemini-3.8-flash medium, agy claude-sonnet-5-5 low, claude haiku

busyAt.title: Busy at (percent used)
busyAt.description: A sized seat passes over a candidate whose 5-hour or weekly window is used this much, or whose week is used faster than it has passed.

mixFanouts.title: Mix model families in fan-outs
mixFanouts.description: Tell the session to put one seat of each installed CLI beside the Claude agents in every review or verification fan-out.
